proposals.evidence: Turner explicitly compares Khowar paránu, Palula purōṇo, Kohistani Shina pōṇṷ, Punjabi purānā, Assamese purān and Oriya puruṇā under purāṇa ancient/old. These whole survey adjectives fit that regional series, including shortened Kohistani por-/pur- forms and eastern purun-/purn- forms. The family comparison does not claim a detailed derivation of every nasal vowel or consonant reduction; extended or additional-word responses are excluded.
